Extract Psychometric Rasch Model Diagnostics and Equating Metrics

Source: R/validate_rasch.R
validate_rasch.Rd

Retrieves item-level Rasch parameters (`severity_b`, `se_b`, `infit`, `outfit`), FAO global standard severities (`global_st`, `adj_global_st`), raw-score latent parameters, and scale-level psychometric validity summaries (flat Rasch reliability, correlation with the global reference standard, and first residual PCA eigenvalue) from a dataset prepared with [prepare_fies()].

Usage

validate_rasch(data, year = NULL)

Arguments

data

A `fies_tbl` object returned by [prepare_fies()].

year

Optional integer vector filtering specific survey year(s).

Value

An object of class `"fies_validation"` (a named list containing three tibbles: `summary`, `items`, and `raw_scores`, plus `models` metadata for plotting).

Examples

df_demo <- prepare_fies(sample_data = fies_sample, quiet = TRUE)
val <- validate_rasch(df_demo)
val
